name: UnzipFilesNode
label: Unzip Files
description: Extracts files from a ZIP archive to a specified destination folder.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: ArchivePath
fields.label: Archive Path
fields.description: The full path of the ZIP file to extract.

fields.name: DestinationFolder
fields.label: Destination Folder
fields.description: The full path of the folder to extract the archive to. Existing files may be overwritten.

fields.name: IncludeMask
fields.label: Include Mask
fields.description: Limits the extracted files to those matching the mask. Use wildcards like '*.txt'. Multiple filters separated by ';'.

fields.name: ExcludeMask
fields.label: Exclude Mask
fields.description: Excludes files matching the mask. Use wildcards like '*.log'. Multiple filters separated by ';'.
